length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: The East Australian Current separates eastward as the Tasman Front at a variable latitude, reported between 28°S and 37°S. The cited study does not give stable whole-front endpoints or an along-flow length; do not add this branch to the East Australian Current's coastal floor. A 2019 review found the front rarely distinct in instantaneous fields; a single stable path length would overstate that evidence.
